definitions.full: H2251. chabat [ חָבַט ] verb beat off, beat out (Late Hebrew id.; strike, beat , Arabic , Aramaic , חֲבַט ) — Qal Imperfect יַחְבֹּט Isa 27:12 ; 3 feminine singular וַתַּחְבֹּט Ruth 2:17 ; 2 masculine singular תַּחְבֹּט Deut 24:20 ; Participle חֹבֵט Judg 6:11 ; — 1 beat off , זֵיתְךָ Deut 24:20 . 2 beat out (grain), Gideon בַּגַּת חִטִּים חֹבֵט Judg 6:11 , so Ruth 2:17 , of small quantities; — distinct from threshing on open floor, with cattle; figurative of ׳י s judgment, and subsequent gathering of Israel Isa 27:12 (no object expressed), so Che Di Du; Ges Hi Kn Brd place below 1 ; VB undecided. Niph`al Imperfect יֵחָ֫בֶט Isa 28:27 fennel ( קֵצַךְ ) beaten out בַּמַּטֶּה . חֳבָיָה חֲבִיָּה, חֲבָיָה, see below חבה . חֶבְיוֺן see below חבה .
